mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in periods of sustained RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in periods of sustained INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200,000 new jobs per month signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in periods of sustained high PAYEMS growth (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in periods of sustained high FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 700,000 units signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction sector earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in periods of sustained high HOUST (t-test p > 0.10).
